recommended_actions.React: Build a responsive React application showcasing component reusability, state management, and API integration, and include it under Projects.
recommended_actions.REST APIs: Integrate asynchronous RESTful API calls with error handling and loading indicators in an existing frontend project.
recommended_actions.Responsive Design: Ensure projects implement mobile-first responsive design utilizing modern CSS Grid/Flexbox and media queries.
recommended_actions.Git: Publish your portfolio and projects to GitHub with structured commits and descriptive README documentation.

recommended_actions.SQL: Write complex SQL queries involving aggregations, window functions, and multi-table joins on real-world datasets and document them.
recommended_actions.Pandas: Perform end-to-end exploratory data analysis (EDA) and data cleaning on public datasets using Python and Pandas.
recommended_actions.Data Visualization: Create an interactive dashboard using Power BI/Tableau or Python visualization libraries (Matplotlib/Seaborn) highlighting business insights.
recommended_actions.Excel: Highlight hands-on experience with advanced Excel functions such as VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, and data modeling.

recommended_actions.Selenium: Build an automated end-to-end browser test suite using Selenium WebDriver for key user workflows (login, checkout).
recommended_actions.Test Cases: Document a formal test matrix including functional, boundary, regression, and negative test cases for a sample web application.
recommended_actions.Postman: Create automated API test collections with response assertion scripts and environment variables in Postman.
recommended_actions.Bug Reporting: Demonstrate understanding of bug lifecycles by writing detailed defect reports with reproducible steps and severity levels.

recommended_actions.Linux: Practice essential Linux CLI commands for process management, log inspection (grep/tail), and file permissions.
recommended_actions.Networking: Familiarize yourself with core networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/HTTPS) and diagnostic tools (ping, traceroute).
recommended_actions.Ticketing Systems: Document experience with incident management workflows, SLA tracking, and structured customer communication in ticketing systems.
recommended_actions.Troubleshooting: Frame past support/technical problem resolutions using a structured hypothesis-testing methodology in resume bullets.
